title: lifecycle-invariants.json names the wave symbols l6t deleted; the Go conformance reader fails until the bundle is re-cut
body: contracts/lifecycle-invariants.json's `today.symbols` for invariants A1, A3, A4, A6, A7, A9, A11 pin runWaveBatch, superviseWaveLoop, WAVE_LEG_MS, MAX_WAVE_LEGS, waveSpawnBudget, waveLeaseHeartbeat, DEFAULT_WAIT_POLL_MS, MAX_WORKER_DISPATCHES, readWaveRequest, manifestRecorder, writeWaveOutcomes, cloudWaveLoss, describeCloudWaveLoss, tripFromCancellation, and site A2 on the deleted file cloud/factory/src/reconcile.ts. internal/factory/lifecycle's TestNamedSymbolsExistInTheFilesThatClaimThem therefore fails on this branch, and contracts/ is un-editable here by rule. Ticks needs to re-point those sites at the machinery that now carries each invariant (the door's spawn/salvage/teardown ordering, the executor's collect, finalize's revoke-before-destroy, the run_event feed), cut a new bundle version, and ticfac adopts it in one commit.
